idea-plugin.name: Source Tree Advance
idea-plugin.description:
A SourceTree-style Git client inside any JetBrains IDE, for any project: no separate Git app needed.

History: commit graph (local, all or current branch) with branch / tag labels, search, author filter, changed files and the IDE diff. File status: stage / unstage files or single hunks, discard, commit or amend and optionally push. Pull, Push, Fetch, branches, tags and stashes; every command that changes the repo is written to Logs.

Any project layout: opens the project's repository from any subfolder, or the first one in its content roots or subfolders.
Look: flat Metro style in greens, light or dark with the IDE's theme. Diffs open in a large window with Expand.
Sign-in: when a remote refuses, asks how to sign in and tries again: access token, username and password, Bearer token, SSH key with passphrase, SSH password, or trusting a new SSH host key. Sign-ins are kept in the IDE password safe; Git's own credential helpers still work first.
Commit options: author, sign-off, GPG / SSH signature, Git hooks on or off; reformat, rearrange and optimize imports before committing; code analysis, new TODOs and a run configuration before or after it.
